title: Watch sunset across white gypsum dunes

location.label: White Sands National Park, New Mexico

description: Drive through the dune fields and use the accessible Interdune Boardwalk. Pink, lavender and blue evening light is the main event.
teaser: Drive through the dune fields and use the accessible Interdune Boardwalk.
